text:
maria: Hey team — start Vela-v1 q5k bringup logs here. Quick summary: baseline fp16 -> ok; q5k quant shows: 1) JA/KR detokenization oddness (extra ZWSP like gaps in kana/han), 2) Arabic bracket mirroring flips for ')' vs '）' in RTL output, 3) occasional prefix repetition when using prefix caching and batching.

kenji: Can you paste a minimal repro? sample inputs + model config pls.

maria: Repro below. Note we run tokenizer v2.1 with locale heuristics on. Config: `quant_scheme: q5_k`, `kvcache: enabled`, `batch_size: 8`, `max_seq: 1024`.

maria: ```
# input JA
「今日は、天気がいいですね。」
# model call
POST /v1/generate
{ "model": "vela-v1", "prompt": "<JA> 今日は、天気がいいですね。", "max_tokens": 60, "quant": "q5_k" }
```

ali: Output?

maria: Output (truncated):
```
今日は 、 天気 が いい です 。
```
maria: Notice the extra spaces between kanji/kana tokens — not present in fp16 baseline.

sara: Is tokenizer v2.1 mapping ZWSP during detok? Could be a post-detok normalization ordering bug.

noah: For Arabic bracket issue here's a small example: input with parentheses around quoted text.

maria: ```
# input AR
قالَ: (هذا مثال)
# q5k output
قالَ: ）هذا مثال（
```

maria: Closing/opening parens got mirrored and switched — looks like bidi/rendering transform applied incorrectly post-generation.

kenji: Two hypotheses: 1) quant kernels changed codepoint ordering around bidirectional neutral chars; 2) detok normalization ran after bidi shaping step in wrong direction.

ali: I ran a diff between fp16 and q5k token sequences on same prompt. Token ids diverge at position 12 onward, but pre-detok unicode codepoints mapping table shows identical mapping. So divergence is probably model-side generation (quant noise) not tokenizer mapping.

maria: Also saw prefix-repeat case when kvcache+batches>1: sometimes the prefix sentence repeats once mid-output. Small log: `repeat_detected at step 34, token 1273 == token 1273 earlier`.

deploy-bot: Canary run completed on staging host vela-prod-5 with commit a1b2c3. 4 tests failed.

noah: Can you attach failing eval ids from the nightly suite?

maria: Eval ids: `eval-2026-03-20-ja-detok-01`, `eval-2026-03-20-ar-bidi-02`, `eval-2026-03-20-pref-repeat-03`. I've uploaded sample diffs to the artifact store: s3://redwood-evals/vela-v1/q5k/2026-03-20/diffs.tar.gz

kenji: I'll run kernel parity and rerun quantization with `--disable-bidi-opt` to isolate. Also will try re-running detok with earlier normalizer order.

ali: FYI BLEU on our 2k JA test set dropped from 28.4 (fp16) -> 25.1 (q5k). TER increased +4.6. For AR bidi bracket F1 dropped from .987 -> .912 on our quoted-parentheses QA passthrough check.

sara: Thanks. Action items: (1) kenji to run kernel parity and detok-order test (ETA today), (2) ali to run token-level alignment diffs and produce top-10 diverging ngrams (ETA tomorrow), (3) maria to collect kvcache traces and sample ids for prefix-repeat (ETA EOD), (4) noah to gate canary until q5k quality passes threshold or fallback to q8.

noah: Quick ask — can we also test a `q5_k-shared` variant (shared centroid table) to see if it reduces noise?

kenji: Will try, launching parallel grid: q5k, q5k-shared, q8 on staging. Pushing job IDs to thread when ready.

maria: Thanks all. Dropping a tiny script that extracts token diffs to speed ali's work:```python
# token-diff.py (toy)
def diff(a,b):
    return [(i,x,y) for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a,b)) if x!=y][:20]
```

sara: Nice. Also tagging @product (FYI) — might impact JP/KR customers if we ship q5k by default for Dedicated.

maria: ping @kenji when you have the kernel logs. I'll attach samples to the eval ticket. :mag_right:
